title: Rezoning to allow new building at 63-02 Fresh Pond Road, Queens
summary: This application would change the zoning map to shift property from an R5B district to an R6A district and add a C2-4 commercial overlay at 63-02 Fresh Pond Road in Ridgewood, Queens. The change would allow a new seven-story mixed-use building with about 53,100 square feet of floor area and 54 apartments, 13 of them income-restricted. The Council's Land Use Committee recommended approval on July 14, 2026.
